properties.description: Braxton Cook is an American jazz saxophonist and vocalist recognized for his innovative blend of jazz, soul, and hip hop influences. He is noted for his smooth saxophone tone and expressive vocal style, contributing to contemporary jazz's evolution by incorporating modern urban sounds.

Ibeyi is a French-Cuban musical duo consisting of twin sisters Lisa-Kaind├⌐ and Naomi Diaz. Their music is a unique blend of Afro-Cuban rhythms, soul, jazz, and electronic elements, often incorporating Yoruba chants and traditional percussion. They sing in English, French, and Yoruba, reflecting their multicultural heritage. Ibeyi's sound is characterized by haunting vocals, minimalist arrangements, and a deep connection to their Afro-Cuban roots and spirituality.

Jesse Boykins III is an American singer-songwriter and producer recognized for his unique blend of R&B, soul, and alternative sounds. His music often incorporates elements of jazz and electronic music, creating a rich, textured soundscape. Boykins is noted for his smooth vocal delivery and introspective lyrics, which explore themes of love, identity, and personal growth. He has built a dedicated following through his innovative approach to contemporary R&B and his artistic independence.

Kate Nash is an English singer-songwriter and actress who gained prominence in the mid-2000s with her distinctive indie pop and alternative rock sound. She is known for her candid lyrics, catchy melodies, and a vocal style that blends conversational delivery with melodic singing. Nash's music often features piano and guitar, and she has been recognized for her storytelling ability and emotional honesty in her songwriting.

Shamir (Shamir Bailey) is an American singer and songwriter from Las Vegas, Nevada, acclaimed for his androgynous countertenor voice and eclectic, genre-blending sound that mixes soul, disco, funk, synthΓÇæpop and electronic elements. He debuted with the EP Northtown (2014) and gained wider attention with his 2015 album Ratchet and the single "On the Regular." Critics frequently note his vocal agility and gender-defying timbre; his work draws on classic pop and dance influences while incorporating modern indie and electronic production.
